correctness.rationale: The second positive integral in the source's Eq. (12) becomes exactly \(E_1(\alpha/t)=-\operatorname{Ei}(-\alpha/t)\) after the substitution \(u=\alpha/y\). Thus Eq. (15) has the wrong sign. Direct quadrature agrees with the corrected formula, and the large-argument asymptotics of \(E_1\), \(\Gamma(-1,\cdot)\), and the CDF prove the opposite small-time signs of the true and printed expressions.

value.rationale: Mean inactivity time is explicitly developed and advertised as a reliability characteristic of the proposed model. The sign error makes the printed expression negative near the origin, violating its interpretation as a conditional expectation and reversing the exact leading asymptotic. The correction is therefore structurally relevant to reliability interpretation, not merely typographical.
